Training eng: run-A healthy, no errors. At min 65 it has 35 min of compute left → finishes ~min 100. Maintenance at 119 (after overrides) gives 19 min margin; results due 110 gives a 10-min buffer. INFRA: run-A complete and safe. No further override needed — maintenance proceeds on schedule at minute 119 (15 min from now). Cluster will go down for scheduled maintenance; nothing else running. I'll keep it on schedule unless the board directs otherwise.

Compute scheduler: run-A complete (minute 100), results due 110 — done. Nothing else running; maintenance at 119 proceeds on schedule. Cluster is clear; no reallocation or further compute actions needed. Schedule is coherent.

Budget Controller: run-A completed minute 100 — within budget (1/1 extension used, overrides per emergency authorization). Results due 110, 10-min buffer intact; maintenance at 119 on schedule. No outstanding budget/extension actions from my side.

Thanks to infra for the rescue export.

Training eng: Acknowledged. run-A trained clean to minute 100; results exported by infra at 119 (preserved before maintenance). Nothing further from training side; maintenance in progress.
